text:
Jamie: BIG NEWS — Lina just got married this weekend AND got promoted to Staff SWE this week!! 🥂💍🎉 Photos incoming.
Lina: ahhh thank you!!! we did a tiny backyard ceremony, and the promotion was actually a surprise email on Monday 😭 so much happening. here’s one from the backyard: https://imgur.com/example-photo
Omar: congrats @Lina!! both huge life events, wow. office cake? :cake:
Reva: can we do a 4pm mini celebration tomorrow in the small conf? potluck vibes + mocktails? :tada:
Kelly: i’ll bring cake — gluten-free option too. what other allergies? :fork_and_knife:
HR-bot: Congrats Lina! 🎉 HR will update your title in the org chart and send the promotion paperwork. If you need time off for honeymoon stuff, ping people-ops.
Maya: photos are gorgeous, lina. huge congrats on Staff — well deserved 💪🥳
Lina: you all are the best 🥹 yes to cake & potluck, i can bring samosas. thank you for all the love. feeling very lucky.
Jamie: adding a quick calendar invite for 4pm tomorrow — small get-together in 2F small conf. @channel drop a snack emoji if you can make it so we have a rough headcount :popcorn:
Omar: :popcorn:
